name: Context UL-Plus common Isolating base for the Context UL-Plus detectors. Isolating Base c/w Xpert card- UL LISTED
family: Context UL-PLUS UL Listed Xpert Style Analogue Addressable Detectors
summary: The Isolating Base senses and detects short-circuit faults on the addressable loops and spurs. Designed to sense and isolate short-circuits on Context Plus addressable loops, the Context Plus Negative Switching Isolating base can be used in place of standard bases.
